_comment: Allowlist for scripts/ci/check_apk_policy.py, applied to the merged manifest of the release APK. Adding an entry is a security/privacy decision: say why in the PR and keep PRIVACY.md in sync.

permissions.android.permission.USE_FINGERPRINT: optional app lock on older devices (androidx.biometric)
permissions.com.fernwallet.app.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_: signature permission AndroidX adds for non-exported runtime receivers

com.ivy.wallet.RootActivity.reason: main activity; also handles the ADD_TRANSACTION shortcut action (only selects a transaction type)

com.ivy.wallet.PaymentTileService.reason: Quick Settings tile; only the system can bind

androidx.glance.appwidget.GlanceRemoteVi.reason: Glance widgets (library); only the system can bind

androidx.work.impl.background.systemjob..reason: WorkManager (library); only the system can bind

androidx.work.impl.diagnostics.Diagnosti.reason: WorkManager diagnostics (library); DUMP is a system/shell permission

androidx.profileinstaller.ProfileInstall.reason: baseline profiles (library); DUMP is a system/shell permission

androidx.compose.ui.tooling.PreviewActiv.reason: KNOWN ISSUE: ui-tooling is an `implementation` dependency, so this Compose preview activity ships in release. It finishes immediately when the app is not debuggable. Fix tracked in docs/SECURITY.md (move ui-tooling to debugImplementation), then delete this entry.
